newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada's Alberta to deliver budget Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Canada's Alberta to deliver budget Tuesday.

text.p: The Alberta government said on Monday it would deliver its provincial budget on Tuesday at 1630 MST (1830 EST/2330 GMT).
In his final budget speech as Alberta's Treasurer, Jim Dinning is widely expected to announce a 1996/97 surplus of at least C$2.2 billion.

Alberta, which has has over the past four years led Canadian provinces in spending cuts, was the benefactor in 1996 of strong oil and natural gas prices and a robust energy sector. Strong activity was also experienced in the manufacturing, forestry and agriculture.
Political watchers have also speculated that Alberta Premier Ralph Klein could announce a spring election some time this week.
Polls have already placed Klein's ruling Conservative party far ahead with an approval rating around 66 percent.
